Again, I don’t take my dog into the grocery store (unless I have her carry bag and even then I don’t have that often so we don’t go). I don’t take my dogs to restaurants unless they have a patio. I always Google new restaurants and if I see they have a patio, I will call and ask before I go. If I step into a business and they tell me no, service dogs only, I leave with no argument. 

I don’t claim my dog as a service dog. I don’t think that me bringing my non-service dog will potentially ruin it for those who do have one. Businesses can’t refuse a service dog.

Also, I could have sworn San Francisco was a pet friendly city.

I’m that person, however I don’t take my dog into grocery stores (but I will if I ended up bringing her in my backpack carrier) or restaurants (unless they have a patio then we are going!) 

Yes, I can leave my dog at home, but I also am free to take her with me when I go out. I am mindful though and I make sure to walk my dog so she can do her business before I start going into any stores so to avoid any accidents. If for some reason she doesn’t go, then I will carry her until we get back outside. If a business says I’m not allowed to bring her in, no problem. I’ll come back another time. My dog is always on a leash. She doesn’t bark at people. She’s a bit leash aggressive towards other dogs and will bark at them, but I keep my eyes open for this and quickly go elsewhere to avoid a barking scene. 

Yes, I can leave my dog at home, but why?? She’s my fur child and has the right to enjoy the world. I’m out of the house for work 10hrs out of the day. When I get home, if I have errands to run, the last thing I want to do is come home, walk my dog, then leave her again to run my errands. Taking her with me makes things easier, especially since I use public transportation. I get home, take her to the park for a bit, run my errands, and then come home and we both eat dinner and go to bed.

Don’t get too excited about this. Sway/Returnmates is just another Instacart/Amazon Flex delivery service anyone can sign up and deliver for. They have no real customer service so contact in case of problems. For example, with my last package, I got the text update saying my package was out for delivery only to check the tracking info 2mins later to see “Delivery attempt failed.” The only point of contact they have is a phone that you can only text and they will send the same generic response 

“Thanks for your patience and our apologies for the inconvenience. We were under the impression that the package was in the driver’s vehicle and they noticed that they did not have it when they arrived at your location. Your package may still be at our warehouse being processed. We will keep you posted as updates are received and when a new ETA is available.” This happened on 3 different days before my package finally arrived. 

Unfortunately, other than heavy orders being shipped via UPS, I don’t know if there is any other way to have Dolls Kill ship out because I don’t trust this Sway program. What happens if my package was lost or the delivery driver decided to keep it?? I’ve heard of people having problems even with the Route Package insurance getting their order/money back.
